name: The Keepers
shortDescription: The greatest titan-forged, empowered by members of the Pantheon to command the war and safeguard the ordering of Azeroth.
body: The keepers led the armies that broke the Black Empire, contained the remaining Old Gods, stabilized the world-wound, established Ulduar, and directed the works that reshaped Azeroth. Individual duties are summarized here without turning the guided era into separate biographies.
